chamada: Serial works, an art wall, film club, book club and the community playlist, all under pen names.

privacidade.semLista: Nobody sees who follows a work, who went to a screening, who is reading a book or who added a link. The author only sees how many people follow her work, and only from 3 on.
privacidade.semNumero: Only you see your own reading progress, and only the latest one is stored, without a date. The group appears added up, and only with 3 readers or more.
privacidade.naoCifrado: This is not end-to-end encrypted: it is like a community post. Do not put here what you would not say in public.

comunidade.nenhuma: You are not in any community yet. The film club, the bookshelf and the playlist live inside a community: join one to use them.
comunidade.soLer: You can read, but only community members write here.

obras.ajuda: Short story, cordel, poetry or comics in chapters. Each chapter is a post of yours that is already out, with the same rules about who sees it. Followers get a new-chapter alert, without the chapter text.
obras.seguirAjuda: Following only serves to get the new-chapter alert. The author does not know who follows.
obras.poucosSeguidores: Fewer than 3 people follow this work (the number only shows from 3 on).
obras.perguntaTirarCapitulo: Remove this chapter from the work? The post stays up.

nova.feita: Work created. Now link the first chapter.

ligar.ajuda: Publish the chapter as a post of yours on Alumia and paste its address here. Encrypted posts and replies do not count.
ligar.feito: Chapter linked. Followers who can see the post get the alert.
ligar.enderecoRuim: I did not recognise the address. Paste the post link (…/alumia/p/…).

obras.perguntaApagar: Delete the work? The chapter posts stay up; only the link goes away.

mural.ajuda: Each person’s portfolio under their pen name. Each piece is a post of yours: it only shows to those who can see the post.
mural.portfolioAjuda: Type someone’s @ to see only their pieces.
mural.perguntaTirar: Remove this piece from the portfolio? The post stays up.

nova.titulo: Add a piece to the portfolio
nova.ajuda: Publish the piece as a post of yours (image, audio or text) and paste its address here.
nova.enderecoRuim: I did not recognise the address. Paste the post link (…/alumia/p/…).

cine.ajuda: Screenings are community meetings in a public place. The diary keeps what the circle talked about, without saying who wrote it. Nobody counts who watched: there is no ranking here.

marcar.ajuda: Only the community moderators schedule. Always in a public place: the database refuses a home address (street with number, postcode).
marcar.localRuim: That looks like a home address. Use a public place (square, library, union hall).
marcar.anoRuim: The year is a 4-digit number, from 1880 on.

cine.perguntaTirarNota: Remove this note from the diary?

leitura.ajuda: The community bookshelf. Only you see your progress; the group’s appears added up, only with 3 readers or more, and the average comes in steps of 10.
leitura.grupoPouco: The group’s progress shows with 3 readers or more.
leitura.perguntaTirar: Remove the book from the shelf? Progress and quotes go with it.

novo.titulo: Add a book to the shelf
novo.feito: Book on the shelf, as next up.

playlist.ajuda: Links only. The title and image come from the preview made by the Alumia server; your device does not talk to the music service. Links open outside Alumia.
playlist.perguntaTirar: Remove this link from the playlist?

nova.semPrevia: Could not read the preview; the link goes in with the site name.
nova.urlRuim: Use a link starting with https:// or http://, with no user name or password.

erros.desligado: Culture is not switched on yet.
erros.nao_encontrado: Not found. It may have been removed, or you cannot see it.
erros.muitas: This list has reached its limit.
erros.muitos: This work has reached its chapter limit.
erros.dado_pessoal: That looks like a home address. Use a public place.
erros.muitos_pedidos: Too many requests in a short time. Wait a little.
